Engineering Breakthrough: Two-Tier Stacked Plate Recognition

Challenge: Vehicles like Honda City feature two-tier stacked plates (Top: LEF - 12, Bottom: 3503). Traditional horizontal OCR caused line collisions, dropping the district and outputting only 3507 at 26% confidence.

Solution: We engineered a 2D Spatial Line Clustering Algorithm with Adaptive Dual-Pass Lanczos Scaling. The engine automatically partitions text bounding boxes vertically before ordering characters left-to-right.

Result: Fully extracted registration LEF 3503 with an industry-grade 96.1% OCR confidence score.
